'''Nali''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] member of the [[Mountain Clan]]. Like the rest of the Mountain Clan, she lived in the safety of the [[Mountain Clan village]]. She was [[Death|killed]] by a blast from an [[HMP droid gunship]] while gathering [[weapon]]s with [[Morgan Elsbeth]].<ref name="TOTE" />
